Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner selected C) plasma membranes by conflating “plasma membranes” with the presence of internal, membrane-bound organelles. Both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells have plasma membranes, so C is incorrect. Among the given options, the commonly used distinguishing feature is B) size differences. The Planner also prematurely finalized the task without proper specialist engagement.
